# lib/settings module

EEPROM-backed settings blobs with CRC validation. This page is the reference for the `lib/settings` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC18Fxx5x | `settings` | [`lib/settings/examples/example_settings.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/settings/examples/example_settings.c) |

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/settings` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/settings). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872, 16F873, 16F873A, 16F874, 16F874A, 16F876, 16F876A, 16F877, 16F877A, 16LF873A, 18F2455, 18F2550, 18F4455. Reason: link: irq dispatch needs every peripheral handler.
